picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies the week's dominant story: a sweeping national initiative pairing government, industry, and academia to fuse AI with supercomputing and quantum systems for scientific discovery.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal commitment under the CHIPS and Science Act to seven companies signals sustained policy-level investment in the semiconductor supply chain that underpins all AI compute infrastructure.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restored natural speech to an ALS patient using his own voice — a landmark real-world demonstration of AI's power to treat neurological disease.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5 million NSF AI Institute spanning Florida, Delaware, Princeton, and Penn to advance human-AI cooperation in health care represents a substantial multi-institution federal investment in applied AI research.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope under the Genesis Mission marks a genuinely novel application of autonomous AI systems to observational science.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: RPI's selection for two Genesis Mission projects, including AI-guided rare-earth mineral discovery with Ames National Laboratory, shows the initiative translating into concrete, resource-critical science.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: William & Mary's award to build AI foundation models for particle physics, in partnership with Jefferson Lab and Brookhaven, pushes AI methods into fundamental physics research at national-lab scale.
picks.title: William & Mary receives DOE Genesis Mission award to advance AI-powered particle physics

picks.editorial_note: Florida's six-year, $511 million AI research investment and program build-out illustrates the scale of institutional commitment universities are now making to AI as core infrastructure.
picks.title: AI year in review

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, which lets generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, offers a meaningful accuracy improvement with direct clinical application potential.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's role in the AI Materials Foundry links academic researchers to a global industry network using AI-driven design and robotic experimentation to accelerate materials discovery.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry
